bestFor: Practical technologist workflow: patient preparation, electrode application, biological calibrations, recording quality, troubleshooting, emergencies, scoring concepts, reporting parameters, and introductory sleep-disorder review.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, section titles, and original Sleep Pathways Guild teaching directions only. Do not reproduce the source's prose, figures, screenshots, tables, proprietary scoring text, or study questions.
authorityBoundary: Instructional study support from 2010. Current AASM scoring/technical rules, current ICSD terminology, current BRPT framework, and current facility policy take precedence when criteria or terminology have changed.
currencyNote: Legacy instructional reference; rule-sensitive details require current-authority verification before learner release.
mappingBoundary: Task mappings identify useful reading areas only and are not page-level provenance claims. No existing question is remapped to this source unless a verified source key is added to that question or to the alias registry.
